title: The divisor function for matrices
summary: We introduce a matrix divisor function $τ_n(T,M)$, counting factorisations $AB=M$ for $n\times n$ integer matrices $A,B$ of height at most $T$. For a fixed non-singular $M$, or for the zero matrix $M=O_n$, we prove an asymptotic formula for $τ_n(T,M)$, as $T\to \infty$, using lattice point counting. We also prove an essentially sharp uniform upper bound for $τ_n(T,M)$, for an arbitrary non-singular matrix $M$.
